text:
incident-bot: PagerDuty P-12345 fired for GPU memory pressure in infer-west2b (pool=gen2-rtg-kv). sample: alloc_failed/cuda OOMs, kvcache evictions spike. auto-created thread.

pagerduty: PD alert P-12345 - triggered at 1768054320 - status: triggered -> assigned to alex (oncall). :rotating_light:

alex: ack - I'm taking this. looking at grafana and the recent autoscaler events.

maya: any customer impact yet?

alex: seeing elevated 5xx from infer-west2b AP of ~2.3% in last 60s. logs show repeated `cudaRuntimeMalloc` failures and `kvcache: evict unable to free` warnings.

jonas: i'm tailing node logs now. snippet: ```
[2025-10-11T21:12:01Z] cuda: cuMemAlloc err=2 (out of memory)
[2025-10-11T21:12:02Z] kvcache: eviction loop duration=120ms items=512
[2025-10-11T21:12:03Z] infer: request failed code=503 route=/v1/generate model=gptx-small
```

sre-bot: Auto-mitigation run: attempted eviction boost on pool gen2-rtg-kv, result=partial, rate_limited=true.

alex: trying a quick drain of the worst node (infer-west2b-node-7). running: ```kubectl cordon infer-west2b-node-7 && kubectl drain infer-west2b-node-7 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --force -l pool=gen2-rtg-kv```

jonas: heads-up: draining will cause short-term scheduling pressure; might increase latency for in-flight requests. recommend enabling fallback route concurrently.

maya: can we route new traffic from AcmeIA and NovaPay to gen2-cpu-fallback for the next 10m? they show the highest error spikes.

alex: yes. applying temporary route: ```routes update --from infer-west2b --to gen2-cpu-fallback --match customer in (AcmeIA,NovaPay) --ttl 600``` pushing now.

katie: (from support) Confirmed: AcmeIA reports increased 503s at 21:12 UTC, NovaPay experiencing higher latency and a few timeouts. CS has notified customers and opened support tickets.

liz: infra chime-in: If this is kvcache fragmentation the safer play is to remove the node from rotation and let kvcache rebuild on new nodes. Scale-up will help but provisioning new GPUs is 5-7m.

alex: noted. drain succeeded on node-7, pods rescheduled. eviction rate is still high on node-5 and node-9.

jonas: looking at prometheus: kvcache size per pod: [node-5: 18GB, node-7: 21GB, node-9: 19.5GB], eviction latency spiking to 250ms. suspect KV cache growth due to a new quantized model rollout around 21:05.

maya: rollback suggestion? which model was rolled 21:05? deployment logs show `model:gptq-13b-optimized` rollout to gen2-rtg-kv at 21:04:58.

alex: good catch. I'm pinning traffic away from gptq-13b-optimized on this pool: ```routing rule add --match model==gptq-13b-optimized --to gen2-cpu-fallback --ttl 600```

pagerduty: P-12345 acknowledged by alex at 1768054330. escalation timer paused.

jonas: after routing change, new error rate down to 0.7% in 60s window. older inflight spikes still present.

sre-bot: Auto-ticket created: INF-7892 "kvcache growth after gptq-13b-optimized rollout" assigned to eng-ml and eng-runtime. playbook link: https://redwood.internal/playbooks/kvcache-frag

katie: Customers updated: AcmeIA support ticket #4521, NovaPay #4522. CS notes temporary routing to fallback and monitoring.

liz: i'll start capacity bake (spin 2 extra gen2 nodes) to reduce pressure. ETA 6m.

maya: suppressing noisy pager for gen2-rtg-kv until we confirm stabilization. keeping PD P-12345 open for now.

alex: summary for handoff -> jonas: drained node-7, pinned routing away from gptq-13b-optimized, temporary customer-specific fallback in place, infra spinning +2 nodes, CS notified. watch for `kvcache: eviction unable to free` and any kernel OOMs. if error rate rises above 1.5% re-escalate to infra-liz and consider full rollback of gptq rollout.

jonas: taking over. I have temp watch on metrics and logs. will keep PD P-12345 assigned until stabilization or handback. ping me @jonas if anything spikes.

alex: thanks — logging notes in incident channel and will follow up with postmortem stub. :thumbsup:

pagerduty: P-12345 status updated: acknowledged -> acknowledged (oncall handoff to jonas) at 1768054398.

jonas: accepted handoff. going into monitoring loop. updating incident thread and will prepare initial RCA notes once stable.

incident-bot: Thread closed for new automated alerts for P-12345 (manual follow-ups allowed).
